[package]
name = "ironclaw_common"
version = "0.4.2"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.96"
description = "Shared types, paths, and platform helpers used across the IronClaw workspace"
authors = ["NEAR AI <support@near.ai>"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
homepage = "https://github.com/nearai/ironclaw"
repository = "https://github.com/nearai/ironclaw"
publish = false

[package.metadata.ironclaw]
layer = "contracts"

[package.metadata.dist]
dist = false

[dependencies]
base64 = "0.23"
chrono-tz = "0.10"
dirs = "6"
hex = "0.4"
rand = "0.10"
rust_decimal_macros = "1"
sha2 = "0.11"
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
tracing = "0.1"

[dependencies.rust_decimal]
version = "1"
features = ["serde", "serde-with-str", "maths"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[package]
name = "ironclaw_llm"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.96"
description = "Multi-provider LLM integration with retry, failover, circuit breaker, and response caching"
authors = ["NEAR AI <support@near.ai>"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
homepage = "https://github.com/nearai/ironclaw"
repository = "https://github.com/nearai/ironclaw"
publish = false

[package.metadata.ironclaw]
layer = "substrates"

[package.metadata.dist]
dist = false

[features]
bedrock = ["dep:aws-config", "dep:aws-sdk-bedrockruntime", "dep:aws-smithy-types"]
registry-provider-factory = []
test-support = []

[dependencies]
async-trait = "0.1"
anyhow = "1"
base64 = "0.23.0"
bytes = "1"
dirs = "6"
eventsource-stream = "0.2"
futures = "0.3"
hex = "0.4"
open = "5"
rand = "0.10"
urlencoding = "2"
regex = "1"
rust_decimal_macros = "1"
serde_json = "1"
sha2 = "0.11"
thiserror = "2"
tracing = "0.1"
url = "2"

[dependencies.ironclaw_common]
path = "../../contracts/ironclaw_common"
version = "0.4.2"

[dependencies.ironclaw_safety]
path = "../../substrates/ironclaw_safety"
version = "0.2.2"

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.13"
default-features = false
features = ["form", "json", "multipart", "rustls", "stream", "system-proxy"]

[dependencies.rig-core]
version = "0.33"
default-features = false
features = ["reqwest-rustls"]

[dependencies.rust_decimal]
version = "1"
features = ["serde", "serde-with-str", "maths"]

[dependencies.secrecy]
version = "0.10"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["sync", "io-util", "io-std", "time", "macros", "rt", "fs", "process", "net"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4", "serde"]

[dependencies.aws-config]
version = "1"
features = ["behavior-version-latest"]
optional = true

[dependencies.aws-sdk-bedrockruntime]
version = "1"
default-features = false
features = ["default-https-client", "rt-tokio", "behavior-version-latest"]
optional = true

[dependencies.aws-smithy-types]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies]
proptest = "1"
tempfile = "3"
tracing-test = "0.2"

[dev-dependencies.insta]
version = "1.46.3"
features = ["yaml"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["full", "test-util"]

[package]
name = "ironclaw_safety"
version = "0.2.2"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.96"
description = "Prompt injection defense, input validation, secret leak detection, and safety policy enforcement"
authors = ["NEAR AI <support@near.ai>"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
homepage = "https://github.com/nearai/ironclaw"
repository = "https://github.com/nearai/ironclaw"
publish = false

[package.metadata.ironclaw]
layer = "substrates"

[package.metadata.dist]
dist = false

[dependencies]
aho-corasick = "1"
regex = "1"
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
tracing = "0.1"
url = "2"
urlencoding = "2"

[dev-dependencies]
criterion = "0.8"

[dev-dependencies.ironclaw_secrets]
path = "../ironclaw_secrets"

[[bench]]
name = "safety_check"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "safety_pipeline"
harness = false

[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"

[lints.clippy]
